review_scope: Mathematical sufficient-rule scope, same-object/quantifier boundaries, source bindings and graph connectivity. This is not an independent reconstruction of all inherited open producers.

findings.detail: Both roots retain the exact topDesWin ten-argument sufficient interface, h1/h2/hV class guards, Cabs=2,C0=3,eD=2,eL=0, and one family selected after all Closed thresholds. HX401-to-400 host transport, MT original metric, and ZW terminal implication remain in the route.

TuSize and RankM are proved only on the actual Built construction class A=cls(Q,Lk,E) and its stated target/intersection subclasses, with cT=cTmin. The original common DesignChoices/Bundle producer remains open; no nonemptiness follows from the two conditional properties. The top-level class and design class remain distinct.

The five GLE implication certificates retain the original Forms0, finite character, admS, original HidaSetting guard and family-threshold order. The Nlam inclusion gate explicitly requires the common actual second-layer producer; D3 membership supplies TuSize. The smaller fullness reachability contains neither the three GL4 tasks nor final global-slope assembly.

The three original GL4 fields and the complete eleven-field FamGLmin numerical/lattice assembly remain separate open B tasks. Exact h3 and GL6 certificates discharge their displayed slots only. GLOBAL_SECOND_LAYER_MATCH still carries one original A, Duty, real witness and universal mass/volume data; those conditional joins do not supply an independent family.

The three theta producer predicates and RowsHold0_3 are jointly required on the same selected Bundle, reading, basis, maps, coefficient field and threshold. BTH13--BTH15 now justify the original-action normalization, independently reviewed at the graph-bound proof hash. The base-only cut does not silently retire stronger nonbase requirements of other consumers.

The principal/RH route reaches I, II and V and no Case-III/SeedIV producer; unrestricted Dirichlet GRH additionally reaches Case III. CountI uses its own fixed Kchi (Q(sqrt(-7)) at the principal target), distinct from CountV's Gaussian/quartic source field. CountV keeps the same fixed target; e=1 and ell in {3,7} at RH concern its twist exponent, while dyadic conductors remain unbounded. Universal helpers are explicitly stronger sufficient implementations.

CountII requires all six original HidaPropsAlt fields and P1core on the same ideal J0, for each original rank-four Link, with the common threshold before later coefficient DVR/B/Lambda. RigII remains an opaque open contract; its Kato/AdVanishQ/NewformAut partial refinements are nonlogical and are not promoted to a complete AND supplier.

Completed implication certificates, open producer contracts and still-unwritten implication tasks remain distinct. Shared work and optional stronger/reuse routes do not enter logical reachability. Every one of the 116 predecessor selected nodes is preserved, all five added nodes are connected, and every one of 245 original continuation records and 107 scope groups retains an explicit disposition. Neither leaf count nor backlog count is a completion percentage.

limitations: This graph is a selected sufficient-interface audit, not an exhaustive Lean declaration graph or an absolute minimality theorem.
